statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45292 affects io.opentelemetry/opentelemetry-api 1.29.0, a transitive dependency of jmx-exporter. Upstream fix available in version 1.62.0, but Maven dependency management does not successfully force the version upgrade for this transitive dependency. Alternative remediation approaches under investigation.
